name: Radio Decay
storyline:
You play as a soldier sent into a nuclear wasteland to close unusual anomalies that are emitting intense radiation and mutating bugs into monsters made of fused human corpses.

Explore a dystopian urban environment solo or with up to 5 friends, working together using proximity chat to survive, scavenge gear, and extract. Fly deeper into the city unlocking more dangerous locations, and uncover the mystery of what broke the world.

If you fail to close the anomalies by removing the precious artifacts within them, you’ll be consumed by the ever-growing storm. That is, if one of the many terrifying creatures that stalk the ruins don’t find you first.

Replace arms and legs poisoned by radiation or dismembered by monsters with superior robotic limbs that can improve stats and grant new abilities. Find or buy guns and explosives to defend yourself. You'll need all the equipment you can get to survive deeper in the storm as you fight towards the answers locked away at 'Ground Zero'.
summary: A 1-6 player co-op survival horror set in a supernatural nuclear apocalypse. Drop-pod into an abandoned city to extract radioactive artifacts while being hunted by giant bug-like monsters. Rebuild your decaying body with prosthetic limbs, arm yourself, and radio your friends for help.
